description: This Java class defines the response to a 'ModifyConnection' command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for connection identifiers.

classes.name: ModifyConnectionResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a modify connection command, encapsulating connection ID and related headers, with JSON serialization/deserialization support.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ModifyConnectionResponse with given connection ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object to create an instance of ModifyConnectionResponse.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the connection related to this response.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional as this response does not contain entity data.
